news.title: Suriya Advised Followers to Ignore Digital Clamor
news.summary: Popular Tamil actor Suriya recently met with his fan club members and strongly advised them to steer clear of online controversies. He stressed that wasting time and energy on negative remarks yields nothing, urging them to focus entirely on their daily endeavors.

news.title: Trade Ponders if Rajinikanth's Sequel Can Shatter Box Office Records
news.summary: Rajinikanth's upcoming action entertainer faces enormous pre-release trade targets as it gears up for an October release. While anticipation remains high, trade circles note that the promotional campaign and recent musical singles have yet to match the immense hype of its predecessor.

news.title: Rajinikanth Starrer Eyes Festival Window With Star-Studded Cast
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's 173rd venture, backed by Kamal Haasan's production banner, is moving swiftly through its production phase. The family-friendly thriller aims for a major festival release window and features prominent additions including Telugu actor Ram Pothineni.

news.title: Speculation Rises Around Mahesh Babu's Next Venture Post-Rajamouli Project
news.summary: As Mahesh Babu wraps up his heavy-duty commitments for SS Rajamouli's upcoming directorial, discussions regarding his subsequent film are heating up. Recent speculations have tied his name to prominent directors and production partnerships, though official confirmations are still awaited.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Clarify Controversial Line in The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela have addressed the criticism surrounding a specific dialogue in their recent release, The Paradise. The filmmaker explained that a line labeling the lead character a single-take artist was meant to be ironic, but the context failed to land because key backstory scenes were edited out for runtime. Meanwhile, the movie is performing strongly at the box office and is projected to cross the Rs. 150 crore gross threshold by the end of its opening weekend.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Embraces Vintage Style in Fresh Photoshoot
news.summary: Actress Taapsee Pannu has shared a new series of photographs showcasing a retro glamour look featuring voluminous curls, a floral mini dress, and vintage-toned backdrops. The stylish appearance follows a challenging box office phase with her recent films underperforming. She is currently occupied with the filming of Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?, in which she essays the role of ACP Komal Sharma.

news.title: Sambarala Yeti Gattu Maintained for Sankranti Festival Slot
news.summary: Makers of the upcoming mass action film Sambarala Yeti Gattu have confirmed that they will proceed with their original release schedule despite a clash with another major project. Starring Sai Durga Tej and directed by Rohith KP, the movie is locked in for a Sankranti arrival on January 12, 2027. Producer Chaitanya Reddy stated that post-production is nearing completion, keeping the team firmly in the festive holiday race.

news.title: NTR Prepares to Join Dragon Set Following Injury Recovery
news.summary: Leading star NTR is set to resume shooting for his upcoming action film Dragon in Mumbai starting October 10. The actor had to take a temporary break due to a shoulder injury, pushing earlier filming schedules forward while director Prashanth Neel handled non-NTR portions. Backed by Mythri Movie Makers and NTR Arts with music by Ravi Basrur, the high-budget project is slated to feature a major action sequence during the upcoming two-week schedule.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi's January 12 Vidudala Nears Completion
news.summary: Filmmaker Anil Ravipudi is progressing swiftly with his upcoming project January 12 Vidudala, starring Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty. Following a brief pause while Venkatesh wrapped up portions for Aadarsha Kutumbam, the team is set to resume work with an Ooty schedule in October. Principal photography is slated to wrap up by mid-November, leaving ample time for post-production before the theatrical release on January 12.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Strong Box Office Momentum
news.summary: Actor Nani's latest movie, The Paradise, is enjoying a stellar theatrical run following a record-breaking opening. Directed by Srikanth Odela and produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri, the film sustained solid collections on its third day. Family crowds and general moviegoers turned out in large numbers over the holiday weekend, highlighting strong ongoing ticket bookings.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Unveils a Unique Romantic Thriller
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has been released, introducing audiences to an unconventional blend of romance, mystery, and family drama. Starring Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal, the story follows a carefree youth whose world is upended when the female lead suddenly vanishes. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the musical entertainer heads to worldwide cinemas on October 9.

news.title: Fresh Ramayana Posters Highlight Scale and Mythology
news.summary: Director Nitesh Tiwari's grand mythological project Ramayana has unveiled new promotional stills featuring Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman against a scenic natural backdrop. Another newly released look showcases Yash with a regal crown and intense expression as the antagonist Ravana. Backed by Prime Focus Studios alongside DNEG and Monster Mind Creations, Part 1 is scheduled for a Diwali 2026 release, with Part 2 following in Diwali 2027.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Unveils a Blend of Romance and Mystery
news.summary: The trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird was launched in Hyderabad by Aakash Jagannadh, setting up a romantic tale that turns into an emotional mystery. Directed by Manga Srinivas, the movie stars Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal in lead roles. It is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Pulls Strong Weekend Box Office Numbers
news.summary: Despite receiving mixed responses from critics following its early release, Nani's The Paradise has drawn solid ticket sales and grossed 136 Cr worldwide in its first three days. Director Srikanth Odela's film is performing well in overseas markets and the Telugu states, with the team celebrating its box-office run. Mohan Babu also made an appearance to encourage the film crew and boost their morale.

news.title: NTR Prepares to Join Dragon Mumbai Shooting Schedule
news.summary: Actor NTR is set to return to the sets for a 15-day action schedule in Mumbai starting October 10 after recovering from a shoulder surgery. The pan-India movie, directed by Prashanth Neel and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, will feature high-octane sequences with NTR and Anil Kapoor. Rukmini Vasanth stars as the female lead in the project, which is targeted for a June 2027 release.

news.title: Crucial Box Office Test Awaits Nani's The Paradise
news.summary: Nani's big-budget film The Paradise faces its most critical box office test on Monday after wrapping up a strong opening weekend. Although the movie opened to massive numbers and reached an estimated 150 crore by Sunday night, it received mixed initial reactions from audiences and critics. With a high break-even target to cover, its weekday performance and the lack of major competing releases will decide its final run.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Drop for Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana
news.summary: The creators of the multi-lingual epic Ramayana have shared two new promotional posters featuring Yash as Ravana and the primary trio of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by Namit Malhotra, the film features music by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer, with theatrical runs scheduled across Diwali 2026 and Diwali 2027.

news.title: Nagarjuna's Milestone Project King100 Set to Unveil Tabu's Character Teaser
news.summary: Makers of Nagarjuna Akkineni's landmark film King100 are preparing to launch a promotional video introducing Tabu's character. Directed by Ra Karthik and slated for December 24, 2026, the movie reunites Nagarjuna and Tabu onscreen decades after their hit 90s collaboration Ninne Pelladutha.

news.title: Makers of Vijay Deverakonda Starrer Ranabaali Announce Four-Part Documentary Series
news.summary: Ahead of its October 16, 2026 release, the team behind Rahul Sankrityan's directorial Ranabaali is launching a four-part promotional docu-series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. The episodes will feature Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna, and the director discussing two years of historical research into Rayalaseema's past.

news.title: KTR Applauds Nani and Srikanth Odela's The Paradise After Hyderabad Screening
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR watched the Nani-starrer The Paradise at Sudarshan Theatre in Hyderabad. He praised the film for authentically portraying Telangana culture and capturing the struggles of oppressed communities. Several public representatives joined him for the screening of the Srikanth Odela directorial.

news.title: Industry Buzz Points to Stronger OTT Valuations for Rashmika Mandanna Over Sai Pallavi
news.summary: Reports indicate that digital streaming platforms offer higher valuations for female-centric projects headlined by Rashmika Mandanna compared to Sai Pallavi. Industry trackers attribute this difference to Rashmika's involvement in major pan-Indian blockbusters and her vast social media following. This trend is further highlighted by her recent signing for the MS Subbulakshmi biopic.

news.title: The Paradise Maintains Steady Momentum on BookMyShow by Day Three
news.summary: Despite mixed initial reviews, the Nani-starrer The Paradise grossed over Rs. 115 crore in its first two days. On day three, the film recorded steady ticket sales of 252K on BookMyShow, keeping pace with its previous day numbers. The project is funded by Sudhakar Cherukuri and directed by Srikanth Odela.

news.title: Wildcard Entrant Mithilesh Exits Bigg Boss Telugu 10 with Cash Prize
news.summary: In a surprising turn of events on Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, wildcard contestant Mithilesh accepted a Rs. 15 lakh temptation offer and exited the house. Having entered just a day prior, he chose to walk away with the money after concluding that winning the title under current house dynamics was unlikely. This sudden departure has become a major talking point among viewers of the reality show.

news.title: Nani Expresses Joy Over The Paradise Journey
news.summary: During a press interaction in Hyderabad, actor Nani discussed the unique turnaround of audience response for his latest film, The Paradise, shifting from early negativity to widespread appreciation. He credited the relentless dedication of the entire crew, assistant directors, and technicians for the project's success. Nani also shared high praise for his co-stars and the filmmaking team, calling the movie a long-distance runner at the box office.
